invariants.rationale: If result is not null, it must be the first layer whose name equals the input 'name'.
If result is null, there does not exist any layer with the given name. (Assuming existence of helper existsLayerWithName as a predicate.)
If a layer is returned, its name is not null by contract.
If a layer is returned, 'name' is likely not empty, assuming layers cannot be unnamed.
If result is not null, it was found in 'layers'.
